answer: Rotating wharf assignment. Each epoch, a public randomness beacon (VRF/drand) shuffles agent IDs into work slots, one active slot per agent; only assigned agents can submit that epoch’s task. An attacker must pre-register many identities before the beacon fires, yet each sybil still waits for assignment rather than the raven’s predictable schedule. Per-identity cost: one full epoch of idle compute plus a marble-like sealed registration that locks until shuffle.
